name: Cloud Provider Deals
blurb: Multiyear agentic AI agreements with the large cloud providers.
title: Cloud Provider Deals
answer: Cloud providers sell drugmakers whole platforms for building AI agents across the enterprise. Merck and Google Cloud announced a multiyear collaboration valued at up to $1 billion to deploy agentic AI across Merck's global business.

crumbs.name: AI Adoption and Governance in Life Sciences

reading.body:
Merck's deal with Google Cloud shows that cloud providers now sell drugmakers whole platforms for building AI agents, not just storage or compute.

The pattern is a shift in what a cloud contract buys. The Merck agreement is valued at up to $1 billion and runs multiyear, and its stated purpose is deploying agentic AI across Merck's global business. That is an enterprise-wide commitment, not a pilot. The provider supplies the platform on which agents are built and run, which puts the cloud vendor inside the drugmaker's operating layer rather than beside it.

For AI specifically, this matters because agentic systems need somewhere to run at scale, and the large cloud providers are the ones selling that capacity as a managed product. The deal also shows where the constraint sits. A figure of up to $1 billion is a ceiling, and what the collaboration actually delivers depends on governance and data work inside Merck, which no contract value can settle.

What the data does not cover is the terms, the workloads, the model providers involved, or any measure of results. It records one announced partnership and its stated value, nothing about whether the agents shipped or what they changed.

terms.line: The field of computer science dedicated to creating systems that perform tasks typically requiring human intelligence: understanding language, recognizing patterns, making decisions.
The 2026 package of targeted amendments to the EU AI Act, deferring high-risk deadlines and restructuring conformity assessment.
A hyperscaler is a company that builds and runs very large networks of data centers to provide computing power and online services at massive scale, such as Amazon Web Services, Google, or Meta.
AI capable of planning and acting autonomously toward a goal, using tools and adjusting course based on results.

An AI system that takes a goal, breaks it into steps, and carries those steps out using tools, rather than answering a single question and stopping. The defining trait is initiative between instructions: the agent decides what to do next.

sections.body: Read up-to values as ceilings; the governance and data work inside the deal decides what it delivers.
sections.heading: What it means for a life sciences leader

siblings.name: Governing AI in a Regulated Company

explainer:
Hyperscalers, the largest cloud providers, sell drugmakers the infrastructure, data platforms, model access and agent building tools needed to run AI across a business. Multiyear agreements often bundle cloud migration, data modernisation and AI development, which is why headline values can reach hundreds of millions or more.

The value depends on the work inside the deal: migrating and governing data, building agents for specific workflows, and changing processes so they are used. Up-to values usually depend on consumption and milestones, so they indicate ambition rather than spend.
